class.name: mca_ros2_control_adapter/MockActuator
class.description: Deterministic single-DoF mock actuator for validating the MCA ros2_control boundary. This plugin does not communicate with physical hardware.

class.name: mca_ros2_control_adapter/MockSystem
class.description: Deterministic two-joint mock system for validating the MCA multi-joint ros2_control boundary. This plugin does not communicate with physical hardware.

class.name: mca_ros2_control_adapter/VirtualSystem
class.description: Two-joint deterministic virtual plant for exercising ros2_control effort commands and state feedback. Simulation only; no physical hardware I/O.
